name: EPROD Vendor Invoice
description: Extract vendor invoice fields for EPROD AP with MSA validation and asset code attribution.

bdaSchema.description: Vendor invoice schema covering header, line items, asset code, MSA reference, and tax code for EPROD accounts payable.
bdaSchema.extractionInstructions: Extract every line item with explicit asset_code attribution. If MSA reference is missing, surface as null. Tax code must match the asset class.

vendor_name.description: Legal vendor name as printed on the invoice

po_reference.description: Referenced EPROD purchase order number (may be null for non-PO)

asset_code.description: EPROD asset / cost center code (e.g. PIP-12345, REF-9001)

line_items.description: Line items with description, quantity, unit_price, line_total, asset_code

tax_code.description: Tax classification (TX-E exempt / TX-I industrial / TX-S sales)
